web-guide-idea-17.audience: People curious about growing food and the work behind a harvest.
web-guide-idea-17.offer: Show one real planting or harvesting task and explain your decisions. Your practical experience turns ordinary farm work into a useful story.
web-guide-idea-17.steps.0: Select a task you can explain safely on camera.
web-guide-idea-17.steps.1: Demonstrate tools, crop condition and the next step.
web-guide-idea-17.steps.2: Pause for questions and show the day’s visible progress.
web-guide-idea-17.equipment: A phone on stable support, power bank and weather protection. Keep filming equipment clear of machinery.
web-guide-idea-17.returnReason: Return to the same crop at meaningful stages so viewers see the consequences of earlier decisions.
web-guide-idea-17.promotion: Show the crop before the session and name the exact task viewers will follow.

web-guide-idea-17.metadataDescription: Show a planting or harvesting day and explain the small decisions behind work on your farm. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
